notes: Much faster on Chromebooks and other slow computers: every block was running the flashlight's shader code even with no flashlight on. Fixed - about 45% more frames per second on a slow GPU.

New video setting, Render Resolution (Options > Video Settings > Quality). On Auto it draws the world at a lower resolution only while your GPU can't keep up, and goes back up when it can. The HUD and menus stay sharp.
Smaller download: 23.5 MB instead of 31.8 MB, so the game starts faster.
The horror mods are gone: The Man From The Fog, Cave Dweller, From The Fog, The Obsessed, Face of Horror and Paranoia. The Flashlight stays (Mods > Converted).
Voice chat's HUD no longer blurs the game behind it, which slow GPUs paid for every frame.
